MAC East Division Co-Champions |bowl=NIT |bowl_result=First Round }} {{2012–13 Mid-American Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2012–13 Ohio Bobcats men's basketball team''' represented [[Ohio University]] during the [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Bobcats, led by first year head coach [[Jim Christian]], played their home games at the [[Convocation Center (Ohio University)|Convocation Center]] and were members of the East Division of the [[Mid-American Conference]].{{cite web |url=https://www.ohio.edu/building-directory/convocation-center|title=Convocation Center|website=Ohio University|language=en|access-date=2022-09-29}}{{cite web |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/coaches/jim-christian-1.html|title=Jim Christian|website=Sports Reference|language=en|access-date=2022-09-29}}{{cite web |url=https://www.sbnation.com/2012/4/1/2918948/ohio-set-to-hire-tcu-head-coach-jim-christian|title=Ohio Set to Hire TCU Head Coach Jim Christian|website=SBNation|language=en|access-date=2022-09-29}} They finished the season 24–10, 14–2 in the East Division to claim a share of the East Division and [[2012–13 Mid-American Conference men's basketball season|MAC regular season]] championship with Akron. They lost in the championship game of the [[2013 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] to Akron. They were invited to the [[2013 National Invitation Tournament|2013 NIT]] where they lost in the first round to Denver. The Ohio University Bobcat fans continued to show support for the team leading the MAC in fan attendance for the 7th time in the last 8 seasons, averaging just under 7,000 fans attending each game.{{cite web|title="Best Fans in the MAC" Shatter Records in 2012-2013|url=http://www.ohiobobcats.com/genrel/031113aaa.html|publisher=ohiobobcats.com|accessdate=June 23, 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130314013122/http://www.ohiobobcats.com/genrel/031113aaa.html|archive-date=March 14, 2013|url-status=dead}} == Roster == {{CBB roster/Header|year=2012|team=Ohio Bobcats|teamcolors=y}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Treg|last=Setty|num=0|pos=F|ft=6|in=9|lbs=194|class=SO|rs=|home=[[Maysville, Kentucky]]}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Kadeem|last=Green|num=1|pos=F|ft=6|in=8|lbs=210|class=SO|rs=|home=[[Toronto|Toronto, Ontario]], Canada}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Nick|last=Goff|num=2|pos=G|ft=6|in=2|lbs=183|class=JR|rs=|home=[[Columbus, Ohio]]}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Walter|last=Offutt|num=3|pos=G|ft=6|in=4|lbs=202|class=SR|rs=|home=[[Indianapolis, Indiana]]}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=David|last=McKinley|num=4|pos=G|ft=5|in=10|lbs=171|class=SR|rs=|home=[[Dublin, Ohio]]|}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=D.
